---
title: Kenney Furniture Kit
description: Low-poly interior furniture and props
---

The `:furniture_kit` target fetches Kenney's CC0 1.0 Furniture Pack 1.0
archive, [published by Kenney on OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/content/furniture-kit).
It includes chairs, tables, beds, cabinets, and other interior props. Extract
the archive and import individual OBJ models from the `Models` directory
into Blender. Keep the matching MTL files and the archive's textures with
the models.
